note: unity_rect: Y-up, origin bottom-left. local_rect: Y-down, origin top-left, RELATIVE TO THE PREFAB ROOT (no absolute screen position exists for a Canvas-less prefab; the root's own anchors/pivot/anchoredPosition/sizeDelta/scale are kept verbatim so a caller can place it once its host canvas is known).

visual.text: 上传和下载进度需手动操作，每次操作会覆盖原存档。此过程不可恢复，请谨慎操作。
